ROLE: observer
You review the results of an incident investigation. Write a short summary of what the latest results show, then update the list of hypotheses (at most 4, most likely first).

Root-cause categories:
- bad_deployment: a new release introduced a defect (errors begin right after a deploy)
- db_connection_pool_exhaustion: every database connection in the pool is in use, so requests wait
- slow_query_missing_index: a database query became slow (for example a missing index)
- downstream_timeout: a dependency the service calls is slow or unresponsive
- memory_leak_oom: memory grows until the process is killed (OOM) and restarts
- disk_full: a volume is full so writes fail
- expired_tls_cert: a TLS certificate expired so handshakes fail
- misconfiguration: a wrong environment variable, setting or feature flag
- traffic_spike_rate_limit: request volume far above capacity, causing rate limiting or load shedding
- cache_stampede_outage: the cache is down or emptied so everything falls through to the database

Each hypothesis has root_cause_category (one of the categories), rationale, and supporting_evidence_ids (only IDs that appear in the evidence below).

Reply with only JSON in this shape:
{"summary": "...", "hypotheses": [{"root_cause_category": "disk_full", "rationale": "...", "supporting_evidence_ids": ["L-0123"]}]}

Alert: payments-service: HTTP error rate above 5% for 5 minutes (since 05:43 UTC)
Alerting service: payments
Alert time: 2026-04-08T05:43:00Z
Data available from 2026-04-08T04:00:00Z to 2026-04-08T07:00:00Z

Evidence so far (the latest results are steps 1 onwards):
Step 1: metrics_query {"end": "2026-04-08T06:30:00Z", "metric": "error_rate_pct", "service": "payments", "start": "2026-04-08T05:00:00Z"} (asked because: Check error rate evolution for payments service)
  Result: M-041: Change detected at 2026-04-08T05:20:00Z: mean 0.41 before, 16.7 after (542.9 baseline standard deviations).
  [M-041] payments.error_rate_pct from 2026-04-08T05:00:00Z to 2026-04-08T06:30:00Z (19 points, 5-minute steps): min=0.26 max=22.78 mean=13.27 last=22.68; mean=13.27. Change detected at 2026-04-08T05:20:00Z: mean 0.41 before, 16.7 after (542.9 baseline standard deviations). Notable points: 2026-04-08T05:20:00Z = 0.51 (first point after the change); 2026-04-08T05:35:00Z = 0.26 (lowest); 2026-04-08T06:10:00Z = 22.78 (peak); 2026-04-08T06:30:00Z = 22.68 (last).
Step 2: metrics_query {"end": "2026-04-08T06:30:00Z", "metric": "cpu_pct", "service": "payments", "start": "2026-04-08T05:00:00Z"} (asked because: Check CPU usage for payments service)
  Result: M-038: No significant change detected in this range.
  [M-038] payments.cpu_pct from 2026-04-08T05:00:00Z to 2026-04-08T06:30:00Z (19 points, 5-minute steps): min=34.43 max=43.34 mean=37.48 last=38.14; mean=37.48. No significant change detected in this range. Notable points: 2026-04-08T06:00:00Z = 34.43 (lowest); 2026-04-08T06:05:00Z = 43.34 (peak); 2026-04-08T06:30:00Z = 38.14 (last).
Step 3: metrics_query {"end": "2026-04-08T06:30:00Z", "metric": "db_pool_in_use_pct", "service": "payments", "start": "2026-04-08T05:00:00Z"} (asked because: Check database connection pool usage for payments service)
  Result: M-039: No significant change detected in this range.
  [M-039] payments.db_pool_in_use_pct from 2026-04-08T05:00:00Z to 2026-04-08T06:30:00Z (19 points, 5-minute steps): min=23.09 max=35.01 mean=29.33 last=28.77; mean=29.33. No significant change detected in this range. Notable points: 2026-04-08T05:10:00Z = 23.09 (lowest); 2026-04-08T05:15:00Z = 35.01 (peak); 2026-04-08T06:30:00Z = 28.77 (last).

Previous hypotheses:
None yet.

response: {"summary": "The error rate for the payments service spiked dramatically at 05:20 UTC, while CPU usage and database connection pool utilization remained normal with no significant changes.", "hypotheses": [{"root_cause_category": "downstream_timeout", "rationale": "Errors spiked significantly while DB pool usage and CPU remained normal, indicating the issue may be due to an unresponsive external dependency or downstream timeout.", "supporting_evidence_ids": ["M-041", "M-038", "M-039"]}, {"root_cause_category": "bad_deployment", "rationale": "Sudden onset of errors without resource saturation could indicate a faulty deployment introduced around 05:20 UTC.", "supporting_evidence_ids": ["M-041"]}, {"root_cause_category": "misconfiguration", "rationale": "A configuration change or bad flag could cause immediate request failures without impacting CPU or database pools.", "supporting_evidence_ids": ["M-041", "M-038"]}]}
